title: CSOAI public-root envelope v1
description: Merkle envelope over public-state cards. The v1 leaf is the SHA-256 digest of the canonical whole card excluding sha256 and sig_ed25519. This is coverage evidence, not a GSPC measurement or certification. Ed25519 signs the compact preimage {kind, schema, as_of, merkle_root, card_count, did_intended}; card_sha256[] is bound by merkle_root.

leaf_definition.const: sha256(canonical(card minus sha256 and sig_ed25519)) — binds subject, source_urls, tags, as_of, did, surface, unmeasured and payload

sig_pqc.description: Optional hybrid signature. Absent or null means UNCHECKABLE, never implied.
